results.name: planClose: clean windows close now, every dirty one is asked exactly once in window order; force skips; unknown ids ignored; closeAll covers all
guard registry: dirty() is consulted live; a throwing dirty() counts as dirty (fail safe); unregister only removes its own guard; live untitled keys are reported
draftPathFor: injective keys (/a_b ≠ /a/b, a:b ≠ a?b), private drafts stay under /Private, untitled ids validated, unknown kinds refused
draft codec: round-trips; refuses wrong version / kind, NaN or negative time, malformed sha, non-base64 payload, unknown encoding, arrays, junk and oversize text
draftOffer: only a draft OF this document is offered; stale when the file's sha changed since; unknown shas are not called stale
DraftWriter: 5 changes inside the idle window → ONE write with the newest content; continuous typing still drafts by the max-wait; nothing written before idle
DraftWriter: one write in flight; newer content during a slow write lands last (never an older draft over a newer one)
DraftWriter.clear: a write in flight when Save clears is awaited and then deleted — a late draft can never resurrect after Save; clear during serialisation writes nothing
DraftWriter: oversize drafts are skipped with a reason; a failing store sets lastError and the next change drafts again; flush() writes immediately
server: draft writes in /System/Recovery keep NO version snapshots (3 writes → 0 versions); the same reason elsewhere and plain writes still snapshot; %-encoded names round-trip

privacy: a /Private document's draft written through the real PrivacyLayer leaves no plaintext name, content or version on the host (Postgres read directly); the legacy Editor draft path put the same text on the host in the clear
